culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Akiko Mizutani. The motive was that Akiko was going to sell her husband's books behind his back for pocket money while he was in the hospital. But, when Sawada found out the true value of the books, he realized that Akiko tried to cheat him. Sawada threatened to tell her husband everything if Akiko didn't give him more. Akiko even admits that even if she paid Sawada a fair share, he might of continued to blackmail her and she would end up with less money for herself.
